fact: The June 2026 final evaluation of PARECIGUI Phase 2 says 445,000 vital records were migrated into the central E-RENEC database, but the module for new birth, marriage and death declarations was not built, interoperability was not activated, and paper continues to be used.
title: Executive summary, Pilot Project for Improving the Guinean Civil Registration System through the Catalytic Effect of Digitalization (PARECIGUI Ext Phase 2)
